text:
The plate looks like a square side plate of roughly 22 cm. On it are scrambled egg whites, or possibly a soft cheese, along with cubes of cantaloupe and pineapple.

The egg whites cover about half the plate, in a layer roughly 2-3 cm thick. I estimate about 150 g, and at around 50 kcal per 100 g that comes to roughly 75 kcal. If it is cooked egg white pieces, this is about right.

The fruit is about 6 cantaloupe cubes and 4 pineapple cubes, around 100-120 g in total. At about 35-50 kcal per 100 g, that is about 45 kcal.

The total is about 270 g and about 130 kcal. I'll allow a little extra in case the egg was cooked with some fat, which brings the energy estimate to about 140 kcal.
